title: TORNADO - CRASH GUARD v2.0 For Suzuki V-STROM SX 250
description:
Whether it’s the open highway or the daily city grind, your Suzuki V-Strom SX 250 deserves protection that works as hard as you do. Moto Torque’s Premium Crash Guard delivers uncompromising durability, ensuring your ride stays secure no matter where the road takes you.

Acting as the first line of defense, it absorbs and disperses shock energy before it reaches the bike’s body, effectively safeguarding the engine, frame, and essential components. This means that even in unexpected falls or collisions, the integrity of your V-Strom SX 250’s vital parts remains uncompromised, allowing you to ride with complete peace of mind.

With three precisely positioned mounting points, this crash guard ensures structural integrity while evenly dispersing impact forces—protecting your V-Strom SX 250 without unnecessary strain on its frame. Secured with high-grade Stainless Steel 304 nuts and bolts, it delivers unmatched reliability for every mile ahead.

Moto Torque’s crash guard isn’t just an accessory—it’s an investment in confidence, allowing you to tackle every challenge knowing your V-Strom SX 250 is equipped for the unexpected.

So wherever your next ride takes you—the city streets or the open road—trust Moto Torque to keep your V-Strom SX 250 protected, stylish, and ready for adventure.

6 Months Paint/Powder Coating & welding.

Lifetime warranty on Bolts & Nuts.

title: HULK - DOMINAR CRASH GUARD
description:
Introducing Moto Torque's Premium Crash Guard for Dominar 400 – The perfect blend of strength, protection, and style.

Engineered with precision, built with robust 25mm mild steel tubes, designed to deliver unmatched impact resistance and superior rigidity. With wall thicknesses of 1.6mm and 2mm, it’s built to endure even the toughest challenges, safeguarding your ride with ease. The use of Cold Rolled (CR) tube ensures exceptional strength, providing high durability that can withstand abrasion and harsh conditions, so you’re always ready for the road or off-road ahead.

What sets this crash guard apart is its innovative slider feature. A nylon slider designed to absorb the initial impact during a crash or a fall, the sliders act as the first line of defense, reducing the force that reaches the frame of your motorcycle. This not only protects your bike from damage but also enhances safety in the event of a fall.

It also comes with 3 strong mounting points that make sure the impact is equally distributed and no harm is caused to the frame or the chassis.

Comes with high-quality Stainless Steel 304-grade nuts and bolts, ensuring a sleek, durable finish. And with a lifetime warranty on all nuts and bolts, you can trust in long-lasting reliability.

Protect your Dominar 400 in style with a crash guard engineered to deliver superior impact absorption and resilience, ride after ride.

At MOTO TORQUE, we're dedicated to giving you the protection, quality, and peace of mind you deserve on every ride.

Warranty Information:

  • Lifetime warranty for nuts and bolts

  • 6-month warranty for powder coating

Important Note: The crash guard is compatible with 2019 and above models.
